apex.name: Apex
apex.blurb: An Omni taken to its peak: a crown of flames round it, a pillar of light rising behind it, shockwaves pulsing out, a frame of crimson and gold turning, embers rising through it.
apex.how: 10 copies of the same Omni card: the card and 9 spares.

relic.name: Relic
relic.blurb: A franchise's relic: a frame of carved stone and gold with a light running round it, a seal of runes turning behind it, runes lighting up one after another, dust drifting in the light, all in gold and arcane colours. Under the mouse its arcana wakes: a magic circle draws itself over the picture, its rings turning.
relic.how: Complete a set and beat its boss on Hell: then pick one card of that set to become its Relic (one per set).

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.blurb: A card the black hole gave back eclipsed: the card is the moon, passing over the sun behind it. At totality the sky goes dark, the pearly corona blooms, beads of light then a diamond ring flare on its edge, and stars come out. Under the mouse you move the moon: the middle of the card is totality.
eclipse.how: A Mythic or Omni swallowed by a pack's black hole may come back Eclipsed. Every other star it swallows leaves a star shard: 7 shards eclipse a Mythic or Omni of your choice.

bond.name: Bond
bond.blurb: A card two friends got together: two cards, one in each friend's colour, part from it and merge back into one in a flash. The seam where they joined glows down the middle, a thread's two lights meet in a heart, and the friend's name is on it. Under the mouse the two cards merge at once.
bond.how: Only in Bond packs, opened by two friends together (both must be there). Each day you both play the daily gives your Bond a point; 3 points open a pack. You both get the same 5 cards, and maybe the Bond card, linked to both of you.
